findings.text: review_dispatch_refusal's docstring promises that a reader which only reports must not write, but no assertion in tests/test_an_overdue_review_names_why_it_is_held.py checks the pointer after the duty is derived; the property rests entirely on the operand dry_run=True at this line. Changing it to False would make every obligations() derivation stamp a refusal record onto a live run's pointer, and the gate would stay green, so the invariant the new public function exists to provide is unguarded.
